cohort: 233 women with singleton pregnancies and placenta previa
finding: Maternal age under 30 years and history of vaginal delivery were identified as significant risk factors for antepartum hemorrhage in women with placenta previa.
mod_finding: Women with placenta previa who had a history of vaginal delivery may be at significant risk of experiencing antepartum hemorrhage.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was significantly lower in the group with antepartum hemorrhage.
